engine: site core.js simulate/sysTrig/sigOK/rulesFor (WARM=210 bars daily, 60 bars weekly), split 2024-04-01, cost TH 0.17%/side US 0.10%/side charged on both sides
pass_criteria: chosen on build only; test win AND test avg/trade both better than current; test trade count cut <= 40%

changes.change: Add minimum volatility filter ATR(14)/close >= 2.2% for Thai daily signals (threshold picked from build-period quantile sweep). Must also set vol:null in TF_RULES['4H'].TH so 4H does not inherit the daily threshold.
changes.universe: TH liquid (mc >= 5e9 THB, same as site signal lists)
changes.evidence: Every calendar year >= current; removed 87 trades had avg +0.06% / win 52% (no edge after costs); random 119-of-182 subsets never reach this result (p<0.0001, 20k draws)
changes.risks: Build sample small (52 trades); threshold is one of 8 quantiles tried; removes most banks/PTT/CPALL type low-volatility large caps

changes.change: Conservative alternative to TH_D_vol22: ATR% >= 1.5 (smaller gain, fewer trades lost)

Do not show/issue system buy signals (sys/cond) on TH stocks outside the liquid universe (mc < 5e9 THB); the system was only researched on liquid names. Stock pages currently compute sysPlan for every TH stock.

rules_patch.site: in analyze()/sysPlan: if(!liquid(st)) sys=null, cond=null (or show warning)

test.note: small caps only; liquid stocks in same period 182 trades 63.7% +1.98%

changes.risks: Not a build-selected filter (small caps were profitable in build but at half the liquid edge); it is a consistency fix with the research universe

changes.change: Weekly US: add partial exit TP1 = 2 weekly ATR selling 30% then stop to cost, and hold up to 12 weeks (SL 4 / TP 8 / slCap 15% unchanged)
changes.risks: Build period only 204 trades (2023-03/2024); 2026 YTD weaker than current (win 49.1 vs 50.9, avg 1.38 vs 2.32); hold 12 weeks was outside earlier research grid

changes.change: Exclude bank, comm, materials sectors (build-weak sectors)
changes.risks: Formally passes but permutation p=0.04 before multiple-testing correction (~30 tests run); bank build loss came from 2023 regional-bank crisis and banks earned +4.2%/trade in test; 2025 got worse with the exclusion
Build win actually fell (56.4 -> 55.8); permutation p=0.03 unadjusted

changes.change: Skip a stock in test if the system lost on it in build
changes.risks: Per-stock build vs test avg/trade correlation is ~0 or negative (TH liquid -0.13, US D -0.11, US W -0.03); median stock has 1-2 trades per period

bug_fixes.fix: STRATS/adaptive-weight backtests call simulate() with default P=RULES which has no sl/tp/hold -> 1 trade per stock held to the split, 0 trades out-of-sample, exp=NaN; adaptive weights never activate and the per-indicator table on stock pages is meaningless. Pass explicit exits or remove the feature.
